map.球面扩散声强计算器，输入点声源声功率与距离 r，按 I=P/(4πr²) 求自由: Spherical Spreading Sound Intensity Calculator: enter the point source sound power and distance r to get the free-field sound intensity at distance r from I=P/(4πr²), for source radiation analysis.
map.I = P/(4πr²)（球面自由场）。 1 W 在 2 m 处 → I≈0.0: I = P/(4πr²) (spherical free field). 1 W at 2 m → I≈0.0199 W/m².
map.输入声功率与距离，求球面扩散后的声强。: Enter the sound power and distance to get the sound intensity after spherical spreading.
map.点声源辐射声强 I=P/(4πr²)，随距离球面衰减。: A point source radiates sound intensity I=P/(4πr²), attenuating spherically with distance.
map.估算远距离处的声强用于噪声预测。: Estimating the sound intensity at a far distance is used for noise prediction.
map.与反平方定律联动核算声压级衰减。: Combined with the inverse-square law to compute sound pressure level attenuation.
map.：声功率 P=1 W 的点源，距 r=10 m 处 I=1/(4π·100)≈7: : A point source of P=1 W at r=10 m gives I=1/(4π·100)≈7.96×10⁻⁴ W/m², corresponding to a sound intensity level of about 89 dB.
map.由声功率求声功率级（W₀=10⁻¹² W）: Sound Power Level from Sound Power (W₀=10⁻¹² W)
map.由声压求声压级（p₀=20 µPa）: Sound Pressure Level from Sound Pressure (p₀=20 µPa)
map.球面扩散和 freespace 衰减是同一回事吗？: Are Spherical Spreading and Freespace Attenuation the Same?
map.是：点源能量均匀分布在半径 r 的球面上，声强随 r² 衰减，即反平方定律。: Yes: the energy of a point source spreads evenly over a sphere of radius r, so the intensity falls as r² — the inverse-square law.
map.线声源也适用吗？: Does It Apply to Line Sources Too?
map.不适用；线声源（如公路）按柱面扩散，衰减为 3 dB/倍距离而非 6 dB。: Not applicable; line sources such as roads spread cylindrically and attenuate 3 dB per doubling of distance rather than 6 dB.
